AboveB quantifies every tied local period model, valuation, ring, bridge and induced embedding. Only its Tor-and-mono0 branch is used.

classical_and_foundational_inputs.statement_used: For a number field, arithmetic Frobenius conjugacy classes outside any fixed finite set are dense in its absolute Galois group; the original stronger degree-one version suffices.
classical_and_foundational_inputs.application_checked: GUA16 applies this to continuous characteristic-polynomial coefficient functions on the same profinite G_E and then to finite-dimensional semisimple representations.

classical_and_foundational_inputs.statement_used: Haar averaging on compact groups, Stone-Weierstrass for a self-conjugate separating algebra of continuous functions, and elementary compact-induction/Hecke adjunction. GUA9 proves the needed compact U(n) highest-weight consequence from these and HP4; GUA12 proves spherical uniqueness from the actual Hecke idempotent.
